Resume paused projects.

Removes spec.paused from the manifest of each named project, so slipway fetch and slipway sync act on it again. A project that is not paused prints not paused.

Examples:
  # Resume the paused project dots
  slipway rollout resume dots

Usage:
  slipway rollout resume (NAME... | project/NAME...) [flags]

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
